key.name: toggle-recording
key.description: Accelerator to start or stop a recording session

key.name: cancel-recording
key.description: Accelerator to cancel an in-progress recording or transcription. Only grabbed while one is in progress, so it does not steal the key from other applications the rest of the time.

key.name: repaste-last
key.description: Accelerator to paste (or type, with direct injection) the most recent transcription again. Unbound by default.

key.name: push-to-talk
key.description: Record only while the toggle-recording shortcut is held: pressing it starts recording and releasing it stops. Release is detected from the shortcut's modifier keys, so the shortcut must include a modifier (e.g. Super); without one, the shortcut toggles as usual.

key.name: auto-paste
key.description: Automatically paste the transcription result into the focused window. Terminals receive Ctrl+Shift+V; all other windows receive Ctrl+V.

key.name: direct-injection
key.description: Type text directly into the focused window instead of pasting from clipboard.
